camel_example: aliyun ehpc ListJobs --region cn-hangzhou --Owner user1 --PageSize 10 --ClusterId 'ehpc-hz-FYUr320000' --PageNumber 1 --State finished --Rerunable false
description_en: Queries the list of jobs in a cluster
description_zh: 调用ListJobs查询指定集群中的作业列表
kebab_example: aliyun ehpc list-jobs --cluster-id ehpc-hz-FYUr320000 --owner user1 --state finished --rerunable false --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListJobs

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the E-HPC cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html operation to query the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html获取集群ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the user that runs the job.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188572.html operation to query the users in the cluster
parameters.help_zh:
运行作业的用户。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188572.html获取该集群中的用户ID
parameters.name: owner

parameters.help_en:
The status of the job. Valid values:

all
finished
notfinish
parameters.help_zh:
作业状态。取值范围：

all：所有状态。
finished：已完成。
notfinish：未完成
parameters.name: state

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the job can be rerun. Valid values:

true
false

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否支持重新运行作业。取值范围：
true：支持。
false：不支持。

默认值：false
parameters.name: rerunable

parameters.help_en:
The page number of the page to return.

Pages start from 1.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
当前页码。

起始值：1。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return per page. Maximum value: 50.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。最大值：50。

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

ArrayRequest.description_en:
The job array. If the job is not in a queue, the output is empty.

Format: X-Y:Z. X is the minimum index value. Y is the maximum index value. Z is the step size. For example, 2-7:2 indicates that three jobs need to be run and their index values are 2, 4, and 6
ArrayRequest.description_zh:
作业队列格式。如果不是队列作业，输出为空。

格式为X-Y:Z， 最小值X是第一个索引，最大值Y是最后一个索引，Z表示步长，例如2-7:2，表示作业队列包含编号为2、4、6的3个子作业

LastModifyTime.description_en: The time when the job was last modified

NodeList.description_en: The list of compute nodes that were used to run the job
NodeList.description_zh: 运行作业的计算节点列表

Owner.description_en: The name of the user that ran the job

Priority.description_en: The priority of the job. Valid values: 0 to 9. A large value indicates a higher priority
Priority.description_zh: 处理作业的优先级。取值范围：0~9，取值越大，优先级越高

Resources.description_en: The resources that were used to run the job

Cores.description_en: The number of CPUs that were used to run the job

Nodes.description_en: The number of nodes that were used to run the job

ShellPath.description_en: The path that was used to run the job

StartTime.description_en: The time when the job was created

State.description_en:
The status of the job. Valid values:

FINISHED: The job is completed
RUNNING: The job connector is running.
QUEUED: The job is pending in a queue
State.description_zh:
作业状态。可能值：
FINISHED：已完成。
RUNNING：运行中。
QUEUED：列队等待

Stderr.description_en: The output file path of stderr

Stdout.description_en: The output file path of stdout

SubmitTime.description_en: The time when the job was submitted

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时设置的本页条数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of returned entries
